source.primary_witnesses: MT BHS Codex Leningradensis — entirely Hebrew. Preamble to the final vision (chs 10-12 form a single unified vision-unit). SECONDARY: 4Q114 (Danielc) preserves substantial fragments of ch 10-11; 4Q113 also has fragments. TERTIARY: OG-Greek + Theodotion-Greek substantially agree on ch 10; minor variants at the angelic figure's description (v 6).
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against BHS apparatus + DJD XVI 2000 + Ziegler-Munnich 1999.
source.fetchedFrom: BHS; Ulrich DJD XVI 2000; Collins 1993 Hermeneia; Goldingay 1989 WBC; Newsom 2014 OTL; Montgomery 1927 ICC; Ziegler-Munnich 1999.
source.citation: BHS (Deutsche Bibelgesellschaft 1997); Ulrich et al. 2000 DJD XVI; Collins 1993 Hermeneia; Goldingay 1989 WBC; Newsom 2014 OTL; Montgomery 1927 ICC; Ziegler-Munnich 1999 Septuaginta XVI.2.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 10 — HEBREW, the preamble to the final vision (chs 10-12 form a continuous unit). **MAJOR THEMES**: (1) the appearance of the angelic figure (vv 5-6) — the description directly underlies Rev 1:13-15's Christophany. (2) The angelic-warfare doctrine (vv 13, 20-21) — the 'prince of Persia' + 'prince of Greece' + Michael 'one of the chief princes' as Israel's angelic patron — foundational for the later Jewish + Christian angelology of national patrons. (3) Daniel's three weeks of mourning (vv 2-3) — Lenten/penitential prelude to vision-reception. The narrative dates to 'the third year of Cyrus' (v 1) = 537/536 BCE.

verses.text: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֗וֹשׁ לְכ֙וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס דָּבָר֙ נִגְלָ֣ה לְדָֽנִיֵּ֔אל אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּ֑ר וֶאֱמֶ֤ת הַדָּבָר֙ וְצָבָ֣א גָד֔וֹל וּבִין֙ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֔ר וּבִ֥ינָה ל֖וֹ בַּמַּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: bi-šnaṯ šālōš lə-Kōreš meleḵ Pārās dāḇār niḡlāh lə-Dāniyyēʾl ʾăšer-niqrāʾ šəmō Bēlṭəšaʾṣṣar we-ʾĕmeṯ had-dāḇār wə-ṣāḇāʾ ḡāḏōl ū-ḇîn ʾeṯ-had-dāḇār ū-ḇînāh lō bam-marʾeh
verses.notes: **In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a word was revealed to Daniel, who was named Belteshazzar; and the word was true, and it was a great conflict; and he understood the word, and had understanding of the vision.** **DATING**: third year of Cyrus = 537/536 BCE. **'GREAT CONFLICT'** (צָבָא גָדוֹל ṣāḇāʾ ḡāḏōl 'great warfare/host') — signals the angelic-warfare theme of the chapter. The vision continues for the remainder of the book.

verses.text: בַּיָּמִ֖ים הָהֵ֑ם אֲנִ֤י דָֽנִיֵּאל֙ הָיִ֣יתִי מִתְאַבֵּ֔ל שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה שָׁבֻעִ֖ים יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: bay-yāmîm hā-hēm ʾănî Dāniyyēʾl hāyîṯî miṯ-ʾabbēl šəlōšāh šāḇuʿîm yāmîm
verses.notes: **In those days I, Daniel, was mourning for three weeks.** **'THREE WEEKS OF DAYS'** (שְׁלֹשָׁה שָׁבֻעִים יָמִים šəlōšāh šāḇuʿîm yāmîm) — 21 days. The clarifying 'of days' distinguishes from 9:24-27's 'weeks-of-years'. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Ezra 8:21-23 (Ezra's three-day fast); cf. Esth 4:16 (three days); cf. the Jewish *Tāʿănîṯ Yāḥîḏ* mourning-tradition.

verses.text: לֶ֣חֶם חֲמֻד֞וֹת לֹ֣א אָכַ֗לְתִּי וּבָשָׂ֥ר וָיַ֛יִן לֹא־בָ֥א אֶל־פִּ֖י וְס֣וֹךְ לֹא־סָ֑כְתִּי עַד־מְלֹ֕את שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת שָׁבֻעִ֖ים יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: leḥem ḥămuḏōṯ lōʾ ʾāḵaltî ū-ḇāśār wā-yayin lōʾ-ḇāʾ ʾel-pî wə-sōḵ lōʾ-sāḵtî ʿaḏ-məlōʾṯ šəlōšeṯ šāḇuʿîm yāmîm
verses.notes: **I ate no delicacies, no meat or wine entered my mouth, nor did I anoint myself at all, for the full three weeks.** **PARTIAL FAST** (not total food-abstention but luxury-abstention). **'DELICACIES'** (לֶחֶם חֲמֻדוֹת leḥem ḥămuḏōṯ 'bread of desirables') — wordplay on Daniel's epithet 'man of desires/longings' (9:23, 10:11, 10:19). Self-imposed asceticism as preparation for vision-reception.

verses.text: וּבְי֛וֹם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וַאֲנִ֗י הָיִ֛יתִי עַ֣ל יַ֧ד הַנָּהָ֛ר הַגָּד֖וֹל ה֥וּא חִדָּֽקֶל׃
verses.translit: ū-ḇə-yōm ʿeśrîm wə-ʾarbāʿāh la-ḥōḏeš hā-rîšōn wa-ʾănî hāyîṯî ʿal yaḏ han-nāhār hag-gāḏōl hūʾ Ḥiddāqel
verses.notes: **On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was standing on the bank of the great river, that is, the Tigris...** **DATING**: 24 Nisan (March-April). The three-week mourning preceded this date, suggesting it spanned through Passover (15-21 Nisan) — Daniel mourned through the great feast. **GEOGRAPHY**: חִדָּקֶל (Ḥiddāqel) = the Tigris (Akkadian Idiqlat) — Daniel is in Mesopotamia, not Persia. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Gen 2:14 (the Tigris as one of Eden's four rivers).

verses.text: וָאֶשָּׂ֤א אֶת־עֵינַי֙ וָאֵ֔רֶא וְהִנֵּ֥ה אִישׁ־אֶחָ֖ד לָב֣וּשׁ בַּדִּ֑ים וּמָתְנָ֥יו חֲגֻרִ֖ים בְּכֶ֥תֶם אוּפָֽז׃
verses.translit: wā-ʾeśśāʾ ʾeṯ-ʿênay wā-ʾēreʾ wə-hinnēh ʾîš-ʾeḥāḏ lāḇūš baddîm ū-moṯnāyw ḥăḡurîm bə-ḵeṯem ʾÛp̄āz
verses.notes: **I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, a man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with gold of Uphaz.** **THE ANGELIC FIGURE — MAJOR CHRISTOPHANY-PARALLEL**: 'man clothed in linen' (אִישׁ לָבוּשׁ בַּדִּים ʾîš lāḇūš baddîm) — priestly garment (cf. Lev 16:4 the high priest on Yom Kippur). **'GOLD OF UPHAZ'** (כֶּתֶם אוּפָז keṯem ʾÛp̄āz) — high-grade gold; Uphaz unknown — perhaps Ophir. **CROSS-CORPUS — MAJOR**: cf. Rev 1:13 ('clothed with a long robe and with a golden sash around his chest') — direct Dan 10:5 inheritance describing the risen Christ. cf. Ezek 9:2-3, 9:11; 10:2, 6-7 (the 'man clothed in linen' in Ezekiel — likely the same angelic figure-type). cf. Dan 12:6-7 (the same figure reappears). The angelic figure here is widely identified as Gabriel (per the broader vision-context) or a higher angel (possibly the *bar ʾĕnāš* of 7:13).

verses.text: וּגְוִיָּת֣וֹ כְתַרְשִׁ֗ישׁ וּפָנָ֞יו כְּמַרְאֵ֤ה בָרָק֙ וְעֵינָיו֙ כְּלַפִּ֣ידֵי אֵ֔שׁ וּזְרֹֽעֹתָיו֙ וּמַרְגְּלֹתָ֔יו כְּעֵ֖ין נְחֹ֣שֶׁת קָלָ֑ל וְק֥וֹל דְּבָרָ֖יו כְּק֥וֹל הָמֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: ū-ḡəwiyyāṯō ḵə-ṯaršîš ū-p̄ānāyw kə-marʾēh ḇārāq wə-ʿênāyw kə-lappîḏê ʾēš ū-zərōʿōṯāyw ū-marḡəlōṯāyw kə-ʿên nəḥōšeṯ qālāl wə-qōl dəḇārāyw kə-qōl hāmōn
verses.notes: **His body was like beryl, his face like the appearance of lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and legs like the gleam of burnished bronze, and the sound of his words like the noise of a multitude.** **THE ANGELIC DESCRIPTION — MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS NODE FOR REV 1:13-15**: **SIX-PART PHYSICAL DESCRIPTION**: body (תַּרְשִׁישׁ taršîš = beryl/chrysolite); face (lightning); eyes (flaming torches — לַפִּידֵי אֵשׁ lappîḏê ʾēš); arms (burnished bronze); legs (burnished bronze); voice (multitude-sound). **CROSS-CORPUS — DIRECT REVELATION PARALLEL**: Rev 1:14-15: 'his eyes were like a flame of fire (ὡς φλὸξ πυρός), his feet were like burnished bronze (χαλκολιβάνῳ), refined as in a furnace, and his voice was like the roar of many waters (ὡς φωνὴ ὑδάτων πολλῶν)' — the John-of-Patmos Christophany is a direct expansion of Dan 10:6. Combined with Dan 7:9 (Ancient of Days white hair) + Dan 7:13 (Son of Man clouds-coming), Rev 1:13-15 fuses three Daniel passages onto the risen Christ. cf. Ezek 1:7 ('feet... gleamed like burnished bronze'). cf. Rev 2:18 (the same description repeated for the church-letters).

verses.text: וְרָאִיתִי֩ אֲנִ֨י דָנִיֵּ֤אל לְבַדִּי֙ אֶת־הַמַּרְאָ֔ה וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֣וּ עִמִּ֔י לֹ֥א רָא֖וּ אֶת־הַמַּרְאָ֑ה אֲבָ֗ל חֲרָדָ֤ה גְדֹלָה֙ נָפְלָ֣ה עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וַֽיִּבְרְח֖וּ בְּהֵחָבֵֽא׃
verses.translit: wə-rāʾîṯî ʾănî Dāniyyēʾl lə-ḇaddî ʾeṯ-ham-marʾāh wə-hā-ʾănāšîm ʾăšer hāyū ʿimmî lōʾ rāʾū ʾeṯ-ham-marʾāh ʾăḇāl ḥărāḏāh ḡəḏōlāh nāp̄əlāh ʿălêhem way-yiḇrəḥū bə-hē-ḥāḇēʾ
verses.notes: **I, Daniel, alone saw the vision; the men who were with me did not see the vision, but a great trembling fell upon them, and they fled to hide themselves.** **THE SELECTIVE-VISION TROPE**: companions sense numinous-presence but don't see. **CROSS-CORPUS — MAJOR**: cf. Acts 9:7 (the Damascus-road episode: Saul's companions 'heard the voice but saw no one'); cf. Acts 22:9 ('those who were with me saw the light but did not hear the voice') — Luke's Pauline-conversion narrative directly inherits the Dan 10:7 selective-vision pattern. cf. Acts 26:13-14.

verses.text: וַאֲנִי֙ נִשְׁאַ֣רְתִּי לְבַדִּ֔י וָֽאֶרְאֶ֗ה אֶת־הַמַּרְאָ֤ה הַגְּדֹלָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את וְלֹ֥א נִשְׁאַר־בִּ֖י כֹּ֑ח וְהוֹדִ֗י נֶהְפַּ֤ךְ עָלַי֙ לְמַשְׁחִ֔ית וְלֹ֥א עָצַ֖רְתִּי כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: wa-ʾănî nišʾartî lə-ḇaddî wā-ʾerʾeh ʾeṯ-ham-marʾāh hag-gəḏōlāh haz-zōʾṯ wə-lōʾ nišʾar-bî kōaḥ wə-hōḏî nehpaḵ ʿālay lə-mašḥîṯ wə-lōʾ ʿāṣartî kōaḥ
verses.notes: **So I was left alone and saw this great vision, and no strength was left in me; my radiant appearance was changed to deathly pallor, and I retained no strength.** Visionary's somatic collapse — standard apocalyptic-trauma. cf. 7:28, 8:27.

verses.text: וָאֶשְׁמַ֖ע אֶת־ק֣וֹל דְּבָרָ֑יו וּכְשָׁמְעִי֙ אֶת־ק֣וֹל דְּבָרָ֔יו וַאֲנִ֗י הָיִ֛יתִי נִרְדָּ֥ם עַל־פָּנַ֖י וּפָנַ֥י אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.translit: wā-ʾešmaʿ ʾeṯ-qōl dəḇārāyw ū-ḵə-šom-ʿî ʾeṯ-qōl dəḇārāyw wa-ʾănî hāyîṯî nirdām ʿal-pānay ū-p̄ānay ʾārṣāh
verses.notes: **Then I heard the sound of his words; and when I heard the sound of his words, I fell on my face in deep sleep, with my face to the ground.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Rev 1:17 ('When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead').

verses.text: וְהִנֵּה־יָ֖ד נָ֣גְעָה בִּ֑י וַתְּנִיעֵ֥נִי עַל־בִּרְכַּ֖י וְכַפּ֥וֹת יָדָֽי׃
verses.translit: wə-hinnēh-yāḏ nāḡəʿāh bî wat-tənîʿēnî ʿal-birkay wə-ḵappōṯ yāḏāy
verses.notes: **And behold, a hand touched me and set me trembling on my hands and knees.** **ANGELIC TOUCH-RESTORATION**: cf. 8:18; Isa 6:7; Jer 1:9; Ezek 2:2; Rev 1:17. The motif of touch-as-strengthening for revelatory-encounter.

verses.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֡י דָּנִיֵּ֣אל אִישׁ־חֲ֠מֻדוֹת הָבֵ֨ן בַּדְּבָרִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר֩ אָנֹכִ֨י דֹבֵ֤ר אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ וַעֲמֹ֣ד עַל־עָמְדֶ֔ךָ כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה שֻׁלַּ֣חְתִּי אֵלֶ֑יךָ וּבְדַבְּר֥וֹ עִמִּ֛י אֶת־הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּ֖ה עָמַ֥דְתִּי מַרְעִֽיד׃
verses.translit: way-yōmer ʾēlay Dāniyyēʾl ʾîš-ḥămuḏōṯ hāḇēn bad-dəḇārîm ʾăšer ʾānōḵî ḏōḇēr ʾēleḵā wa-ʿămōḏ ʿal-ʿomḏeḵā kî ʿattāh šullaḥtî ʾēleḵā ū-ḇə-ḏabbərō ʿimmî ʾeṯ-had-dāḇār haz-zeh ʿāmaḏtî marʿîḏ
verses.notes: **He said to me: 'O Daniel, man greatly beloved, give heed to the words that I speak to you, and stand upright, for now I have been sent to you.' While he was speaking this word to me, I stood up trembling.** **'MAN GREATLY BELOVED'** (אִישׁ חֲמֻדוֹת ʾîš-ḥămuḏōṯ) — Daniel's epithet (cf. 9:23, 10:19).

verses.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַי֮ אַל־תִּירָ֣א דָנִיֵּאל֒ כִּ֣י ׀ מִן־הַיּ֣וֹם הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תָּ אֶֽת־לִבְּךָ֛ לְהָבִ֧ין וּלְהִתְעַנּ֛וֹת לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נִשְׁמְע֣וּ דְבָרֶ֑יךָ וַאֲנִי־בָ֖אתִי בִּדְבָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: way-yōmer ʾēlay ʾal-tîrāʾ Dāniyyēʾl kî min-hay-yōm hā-rîšōn ʾăšer nāṯattā ʾeṯ-libbə-ḵā lə-hāḇîn ū-lə-hiṯʿannōṯ lip̄nê ʾĔlōheḵā nišməʿū ḏəḇāreḵā wa-ʾănî-ḇāʾṯî bi-ḏḇāreḵā
verses.notes: **Then he said to me: 'Fear not, Daniel, for from the first day that you set your mind to understand and humbled yourself before your God, your words have been heard, and I have come because of your words.'** Daniel's prayer answered from the first day — the 21-day delay (vv 2-4) is then attributed to angelic-warfare (v 13).

verses.text: וְשַׂ֣ר ׀ מַלְכ֣וּת פָּרַ֗ס עֹמֵ֤ד לְנֶגְדִּי֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְאֶחָ֣ד י֔וֹם וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִֽיכָאֵ֗ל אַחַ֛ד הַשָּׂרִ֥ים הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים בָּ֣א לְעָזְרֵ֑נִי וַאֲנִי֙ נוֹתַ֣רְתִּי שָׁ֔ם אֵ֖צֶל מַלְכֵ֥י פָרָֽס׃
verses.translit: wə-śar malḵūṯ Pārās ʿōmēḏ lə-neḡdî ʿeśrîm wə-ʾeḥāḏ yōm wə-hinnēh Mîḵāʾēl ʾaḥaḏ haś-śārîm hā-rîšōnîm bāʾ lə-ʿozrēnî wa-ʾănî nōṯartî šām ʾēṣel malḵê P̄ārās
verses.notes: **'The prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days; but Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me, so I left him there with the prince of the kingdom of Persia...'** **MAJOR ANGELIC-WARFARE DOCTRINE**: **THE 'PRINCE OF PERSIA'** (שַׂר מַלְכוּת פָּרַס śar malḵūṯ Pārās) = the angelic patron of Persia, an OPPOSING angelic being. **MICHAEL** (מִיכָאֵל Mîḵāʾēl 'who is like El') — first named here in HB. 'One of the chief princes' (אַחַד הַשָּׂרִים הָרִאשֹׁנִים ʾaḥaḏ haś-śārîm hā-rîšōnîm) — implying a council of chief angelic princes (cf. the seven archangels of Tob 12:15; 1 En 20). **CROSS-CORPUS — MAJOR**: (a) **1 En 89-90** (the Animal Apocalypse): the 70 shepherds, angelic patrons of nations; the 'Lord of the sheep' as Israel's defender. (b) **Jub 15:30-32**: 'over Israel he did not cause any angel or spirit to rule, for he alone is their ruler' — Jubilees rejects national-angelic patronage for Israel (Yahweh is direct sovereign), an interesting variant of the Daniel scheme. (c) **Deut 32:8-9 (LXX + 4QDeut^j reading)**: 'according to the number of the sons of God' — the proto-text for nations-having-angelic-patrons. (d) **Sirach 17:17**: 'For every nation he appointed a ruler, but Israel is the Lord's portion.' (e) **Rev 12:7**: 'Then war broke out in heaven, Michael and his angels fighting against the dragon' — DIRECT Dan 10:13 inheritance. (f) **Jude 9**: Michael disputing with the devil over Moses's body. (g) Qumran 1QM (War Scroll): the angelic-warfare cosmology directly elaborates Dan 10:13. **CROSS-CORPUS to 10:13, 10:20, 10:21 + 12:1 MICHAEL as Israel's prince-angel + Rev 12:7 + Jude 9.**

verses.text: וּבָ֙אתִי֙ לַהֲבִ֣ינְךָ֔ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָ֥ה לְעַמְּךָ֖ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֑ים כִּי־ע֥וֹד חָז֖וֹן לַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: ū-ḇāʾṯî la-hăḇînə-ḵā ʾēṯ ʾăšer-yiqrāh lə-ʿammə-ḵā bə-ʾaḥărîṯ hay-yāmîm kî-ʿōḏ ḥāzōn lay-yāmîm
verses.notes: **'...and came to make you understand what is to befall your people in the latter days; for the vision is for days yet to come.'** **'LATTER DAYS'** (אַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים ʾaḥărîṯ hay-yāmîm) — the eschatological-terminus phrase. cf. Gen 49:1; Deut 4:30, 31:29; Isa 2:2; Mic 4:1; Hos 3:5; Jer 23:20, 30:24, 48:47, 49:39. In NT: Acts 2:17 ('last days'); Heb 1:2; 2 Pet 3:3; Jas 5:3.

verses.text: וּבְדַבְּר֣וֹ עִמִּ֔י כַּדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה נָתַ֧תִּי פָנַ֛י אַ֖רְצָה וְנֶאֱלָֽמְתִּי׃
verses.translit: ū-ḇə-ḏabbərō ʿimmî kad-dəḇārîm hā-ʾēlleh nāṯattî p̄ānay ʾarṣāh wə-neʾĕlāmtî
verses.notes: **When he had spoken to me according to these words, I turned my face toward the ground and was dumb.**

verses.text: וְהִנֵּ֗ה כִּדְמוּת֙ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם נֹגֵ֖עַ עַל־שְׂפָתָ֑י וָאֶפְתַּח־פִּ֗י וָאֲדַבְּרָה֙ וָאֹֽמְרָה֙ אֶל־הָעֹמֵ֣ד לְנֶגְדִּ֔י אֲדֹנִ֗י בַּמַּרְאָה֙ נֶהֶפְכ֤וּ צִירַי֙ עָלַ֔י וְלֹ֥א עָצַ֖רְתִּי כֹּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: wə-hinnēh ki-ḏmūṯ bənê ʾāḏām nōḡēaʿ ʿal-śəp̄āṯāy wā-ʾep̄taḥ-pî wā-ʾăḏabbərāh wā-ʾōmərāh ʾel-hā-ʿōmēḏ lə-neḡdî ʾăḏōnî bam-marʾāh nehepḵū ṣîray ʿālay wə-lōʾ ʿāṣartî kōaḥ
verses.notes: **And behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips; then I opened my mouth and spoke, saying to him who stood before me: 'O my lord, by reason of the vision pains have come upon me, and I retain no strength.'** **TOUCH ON LIPS**: cf. Isa 6:7 ('the coal touched my lips'); Jer 1:9 ('the LORD put forth his hand and touched my mouth'). Standard prophetic-commissioning motif.

verses.text: וְהֵ֣יךְ יוּכַ֗ל עֶ֤בֶד אֲדֹנִי֙ זֶ֔ה לְדַבֵּ֖ר עִם־אֲדֹ֣נִי זֶ֑ה וַאֲנִ֤י מֵעַ֙תָּה֙ לֹֽא־יַעֲמָד־בִּ֣י כֹ֔חַ וּנְשָׁמָ֖ה לֹ֥א נִשְׁאֲרָה־בִֽי׃
verses.translit: wə-hêḵ yūḵal ʿeḇeḏ ʾăḏōnî zeh lə-ḏabbēr ʿim-ʾăḏōnî zeh wa-ʾănî mē-ʿattāh lōʾ-yaʿămāḏ-bî ḵōaḥ ū-nəšāmāh lōʾ nišʾărāh-ḇî
verses.notes: **'How can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? For now no strength remains in me, and no breath is left in me.'**

verses.text: וַיֹּ֧סֶף וַיִּגַּע־בִּ֛י כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה אָדָ֖ם וַֽיְחַזְּקֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: way-yōsep̄ way-yiggaʿ-bî kə-marʾēh ʾāḏām way-ḥazzəqēnî
verses.notes: **Again one having the appearance of a man touched me and strengthened me.**

verses.text: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר אַל־תִּירָ֧א אִישׁ־חֲמֻד֛וֹת שָׁל֥וֹם לָ֖ךְ חֲזַ֣ק וַחֲזָ֑ק וּֽכְדַבְּר֤וֹ עִמִּי֙ הִתְחַזַּ֔קְתִּי וָאֹֽמְרָ֛ה יְדַבֵּ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י כִּ֥י חִזַּקְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: way-yōmer ʾal-tîrāʾ ʾîš-ḥămuḏōṯ šālōm lāḵ ḥăzaq wa-ḥăzāq ū-ḵə-ḏabbərō ʿimmî hiṯḥazzaqtî wā-ʾōmərāh yə-ḏabbēr ʾăḏōnî kî ḥizzaqtānî
verses.notes: **And he said: 'O man greatly beloved, fear not, peace be with you; be strong and of good courage.' And when he spoke to me, I was strengthened and said: 'Let my lord speak, for you have strengthened me.'** **'PEACE BE WITH YOU'** (שָׁלוֹם לָךְ šālōm lāḵ) — angelic-greeting formula. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Luke 24:36; John 20:19, 21, 26 (the risen Christ's 'Peace be with you'). cf. Judg 6:23 (the Angel of YHWH to Gideon: 'Peace be to you').

verses.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הֲיָדַ֙עְתָּ֙ לָמָּה־בָּ֣אתִי אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְעַתָּ֣ה אָשׁ֔וּב לְהִלָּחֵ֖ם עִם־שַׂ֣ר פָּרָ֑ס וַאֲנִ֣י יוֹצֵ֔א וְהִנֵּ֥ה שַׂר־יָוָ֖ן בָּֽא׃
verses.translit: way-yōmer hă-yāḏaʿtā lām-māh-bāʾṯî ʾēleḵā wə-ʿattāh ʾāšūḇ lə-hillāḥēm ʿim-śar Pārās wa-ʾănî yōṣēʾ wə-hinnēh śar-Yāwān bāʾ
verses.notes: **Then he said: 'Do you know why I have come to you? But now I will return to fight against the prince of Persia; and when I am through with him, lo, the prince of Greece will come.'** **'PRINCE OF GREECE'** (שַׂר־יָוָן śar-Yāwān) — Greece's angelic patron. The succession of angelic-patrons (Persia → Greece) mirrors the succession of empires. This verse is the key text for the angelic-cosmology that subordinates earthly geopolitics to heavenly warfare. cf. 10:13.

verses.text: אֲבָל֙ אַגִּ֣יד לְךָ֔ אֶת־הָרָשׁ֖וּם בִּכְתָ֣ב אֱמֶ֑ת וְאֵ֨ין אֶחָ֜ד מִתְחַזֵּ֤ק עִמִּי֙ עַל־אֵ֔לֶּה כִּ֖י אִם־מִיכָאֵ֥ל שַׂרְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: ʾăḇāl ʾaggîḏ lə-ḵā ʾeṯ-hā-rāšūm bi-ḵṯāḇ ʾĕmeṯ wə-ʾên ʾeḥāḏ miṯḥazzēq ʿimmî ʿal-ʾēlleh kî ʾim-Mîḵāʾēl śarḵem
verses.notes: **'But I will tell you what is inscribed in the book of truth; there is none who contends by my side against these except Michael, your prince.'** **'BOOK OF TRUTH'** (כְתָב אֱמֶת kəṯāḇ ʾĕmeṯ) — the heavenly tablet/scroll. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Ps 139:16 ('all the days written in your book'); cf. Jub heavenly tablets tradition; cf. Rev 5:1-9, 13:8, 17:8, 20:12, 20:15, 21:27 (the book of life). **'MICHAEL YOUR PRINCE'** (מִיכָאֵל שַׂרְכֶם Mîḵāʾēl śarḵem) — Michael as Israel's specific angelic patron; this verse plus 12:1 establish Michael's role definitively. cf. 12:1 ('Michael, the great prince who has charge of your people'). Cross-corpus to 10:13, 10:20, 10:21 + 12:1 Michael as Israel's prince-angel + Rev 12:7 + Jude 9.
